violations.description: Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. - New hood system installed, vented outside, but it does not cover all cook surfaces.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. - Countertop has holes in grout, unable to be cleaned.
Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager is no longer associated with this establishment.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. - New stove installed, needs a hood to cover and vent outside.
Clean clothes, hair restraints, fingernail maint., jewelry, eating/drinking (1 pt deducted)
